title: Three-tag Praxis with public mixed corrections and three witness quotients
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 5476 MiB (5.3476 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 31532 million field multiplications (14638 and 16894), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, P1, C5, n, H3, D, ell, Bsearch, T_tr, dec_sum_g1, search_spread, msis_bound) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
